title: fix(i18n): finish the organizations.* picker rename in eight locale packs
body:
Fixes #5215

## What

The `organizations.*` picker locale family (avatar menu + console picker) was
renamed from "organization" to "workspace" terminology in `en` and `zh` only.
The other eight packs (`ar`, `de`, `es`, `fr`, `ja`, `ko`, `pt`, `ru`) had just
one key — `create` — follow, so each pack mixed both nouns in the same
dropdown (e.g. `de.ts` read `create: "Workspace erstellen"` directly beside
`mine: "Meine Organisationen"`, two lines apart). Since PR #4638 restored the
avatar menu's "My Workspaces" entry, this is on screen in eight languages.

This PR brings the ten noun-carrying keys (`mine`, `title`, `heading`,
`subtitle`, `searchPlaceholder`, `new`, `current`, `emptyTitle`,
`emptyDescription`, `noMatches`) in each of the eight packs into line with the
term that pack's own `create` key already committed to.

## Scope verification (the load-bearing question, per the card)

Confirmed in `en.ts` before touching anything: `organizations.*` (plural —
the picker, this PR's scope) and `organization.*` (singular — org
**management**: members, invitations, settings) are two deliberately
separate namespaces, with a comment sitting between the two blocks in
`en.ts` saying so explicitly. `en`/`zh` already show the intended end state
— the plural family renamed to "workspace", the singular family did not.

This PR touches **only** the plural `organizations.*` family, in the eight
non-en/zh packs. The sibling `organization.*` family is untouched in every
pack — verified both by diff (`git diff --stat` shows exactly 20 changed
lines per file — 10 replaced keys — and nothing else) and by a new test
assertion (see below).

## Translations

Each pack's own already-established workspace term (taken from the `create`
key, which is unchanged by this PR) was used as the reference, with
grammatical agreement (gender, definiteness/case, particles) adjusted per
key rather than a literal string substitution:

| Pack | Term used (from `create`) | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `de` | `Workspace` (masc., loanword) | adjective/article gender flips to masculine (`einen Workspace`, `Neuer Workspace`) |
| `es` | `espacio de trabajo` (masc.) | `una`→`un`, `nueva`→`nuevo`, `primera`→`primer` |
| `fr` | `espace de travail` (masc.) | `une`→`un`, `nouvelle`→`nouvel` (vowel elision), `première`→`premier` |
| `ja` | `ワークスペース` | direct substitution, no gender/number agreement in Japanese |
| `ko` | `워크스페이스` | particles switch from consonant-ending (을/이) to vowel-ending (를/가) forms since `워크스페이스` ends in a vowel sound |
| `pt` | `workspace` (masc., loanword) | `Minhas`→`Meus`, `Nova`→`Novo`, `primeira`→`primeiro` |
| `ru` | `рабочее пространство` (neut.) | fem→neuter agreement throughout (`своя`→`своё`, `новая`→`новое`) |
| `ar` | `مساحة عمل` (fem.) | same feminine gender as `مؤسسة`, so most adjective agreement is unchanged; plural formed as `مساحات عمل`/`مساحات العمل` |

## Why no existing gate caught this

- `all-locales-key-parity` — every pack **has** every key; green regardless of vocabulary.
- `check:i18n-drift` — follows changes to the **en** value; en hasn't moved.
- `check:i18n-keys` — compares call-site keys/defaults against **en** only; the eight non-en packs are outside its comparison set.

All three are structurally blind to a same-language vocabulary split. I'm not
building a general vocabulary-consistency gate (a different, harder card),
but added a narrow, cheap pin for exactly this family:
`organizations-picker-vocabulary-5215.test.ts` asserts, per pack, that none
of the ten picker keys still contains that pack's old organization-noun stem,
and that all ten now contain the pack's own workspace term — plus one
assertion that the sibling `organization.*` namespace still carries the org
noun (guards the separation this fix depends on). A regression that
reintroduces the old noun in one key without its neighbors — the exact shape
of the original defect — fails immediately.

## Tests

All run at `902d98ced` (this branch's HEAD):

- New: `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/organizations-picker-vocabulary-5215.test.ts`
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/src/__tests__/organizations-picker-vocabulary-5215.test.ts packages/i18n/src/__tests__/all-locales-key-parity.test.ts packages/i18n/src/__tests__/organization-namespace-3546.test.tsx --maxWorkers=2` → `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 70 passed (70)`
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) → exit 0
- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/i18n^...' build` (dependency closure: `types`, `core`) → exit 0
- `node scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` → `0 en value(s) changed` (en untouched, as expected)
- `node scripts/check-i18n-call-site-keys.mjs` → all call sites resolve, all literal defaults match `en`
- Lint (`npx eslint` on the 8 changed locale files + the new test file) — clean
- Control-byte scan (`pnpm check:control-bytes` repo-wide + direct `grep -naP` on every changed file) — clean

## Not touched

- `en.ts` / `zh.ts` — reference packs, already correct.
- `organization.*` (singular) — org management, deliberately separate namespace.
- `packages/fields/**`, `packages/app-shell/**`, `packages/plugin-view`, `packages/plugin-list`, `packages/plugin-report` — held by other in-flight work.
